recognize_zh: 高倍下是生發中心內混合的細胞群：核大、染色質開放並有周邊核仁的中心母細胞（centroblast）、核裂狀的中心細胞、少數核仁明顯的免疫母細胞、小淋巴球，以及細胞質嗜伊紅、核偏位的漿細胞與吞噬碎屑的巨噬細胞；細胞組成多樣說明這是反應性生發中心。
features: Polymorphous germinal center population with mixed cell sizes
Centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral nucleoli
Centrocytes with irregular cleaved nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered immunoblasts with single central nucleoli
Admixed plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm, plus small lymphocytes
Tingible-body macrophages with pale cytoplasm and apoptotic debris
describe_en: High-power view of a germinal center shows a polymorphous population of centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral nucleoli, centrocytes with cleaved nuclei, and scattered immunoblasts. Plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and small lymphocytes are admixed, together with tingible-body macrophages containing apoptotic debris. There are no sheets of monotonous atypical cells. The findings represent a reactive germinal center with plasmacytosis, which in the appropriate immunohistochemical context may be seen in IgG4-related lymphadenopathy.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles contain monotonous centroblasts without tingible-body macrophages or polarization and are BCL2-positive with a lower Ki-67 than reactive centers.
DLBCL consists of sheets of large atypical cells effacing architecture rather than a mixed population confined to follicles.
CHL shows diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed interfollicular background and is CD30+/CD15+.
